pages.text: The strongest resins can't be crafted at all: $(l)Quartermaster$() and $(l)Ore Salting$() exist only here. Find them while exploring end-game structures:$(br)$(li)End cities$(li)Ancient cities$(li)Nether fortresses & bastions$(li)Woodland mansions$(li)Strongholds$(li)Buried treasure
Each qualifying chest has a small chance to hold one random Rare resin. They're scarce on purpose: pair a hard-won resin with a hard-won blueprint for the best print of your life.
